name: Golden Insurance Brokers Co.,Ltd.
summary: Golden Insurance Brokers Co.,Ltd. is a Taiwanese enterprise primarily engaged in mediating both life and property insurance policies. The company's diverse service offerings encompass personal and property insurance brokerage, investment consultation, and various management consulting and intermediary functions. Furthermore, it leverages digital platforms to provide online insurance services, a comprehensive insurance planning tool, and a specialized platform for recommending accident insurance. Established in 1982, Golden Insurance Brokers Co.,Ltd. is headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
